findings.title_en: Worker without a hard hat below elevated work
Ladder top below the access level edge
Protection for worker at elevated edge is uncertain
Carrying a large roll while holding the ladder with one hand
Rust-like marks and soiling on the access ladder

summary_en: Five findings were recorded: two high severity, two medium severity, and one low severity. The most urgent item is a worker without a hard hat below elevated work, combined with a ladder that does not extend above the access level. Ladder and elevated-edge work in this area should stop until the high-severity items are corrected and fall protection is verified.
